items: LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.1): Reports Over ₦1Tn 2025 Investment Inflow & $50Bn IATF 2027 Target, Readies 280-Bed Ojo General Hospital & Renovates J. Randle Centre
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.9): EXCO Approves ₦1.4Bn ADSU Convocation Square, ₦249M GSS Madagali Quarters & 2027–2031 Demographic Roadmap; Partners NCC on Telecom Protection
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.7): Inaugurates Petty Traders Grant Committee (₦10k–₦100k), Launches UNICROSS–Zhejiang 3D Printing Training & Delivers ₦2M + Health Cover to Carnival Star
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.1): Procures & Flags Off Water Treatment Tablets in Ifedore LGA to Curb Schistosomiasis & Issues Statewide Heat Wave Public Health Alert
EDO STATE (PSI 7.8): First Lady's Office Flags Off Free Surgeries for 100 Patients in Benin City & EWMB Conducts Benin Sanitation Inspection Tour
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.6): Gov. Inuwa Yahaya Visits Lawanti Shooting Victims' Families, Donates ₦10M Support & Pledges Thorough Investigation
OYO STATE (PSI 7.4): Gov. Makinde Advocates Productivity-Led Wealth Creation Over Allocation Dependence at Ibadan Leadership Conference
ABIA STATE (PSI 7.2): Gov. Otti Administration Uncovers Alleged Plot to Vandalise Campaign Billboards & Offices, Warns of Severe Consequences
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 7.0): Gov. Diri Presents Prosthetic Leg, Salary Increase, Business Support & ₦250,000 Grant to Injured Farmer Defender in Ogbia LGA
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 6.9): Federal Ministry of Water Resources Honours Zamfara RUWATSAN for Open Defecation Free (ODF) Status in Four LGAs
OSUN STATE (PSI 6.8): Gov. Adeleke Delivers Pre-Inauguration State Broadcast Pledging Expanded Infrastructure, Social Services & Job Creation
BAUCHI STATE (PSI 6.5): Gov. Bala Mohammed Hosts Medical Supply Firm Afrimed to Explore Hospital Supply Chain Partnership
KEBBI STATE (PSI 6.3): Kebbi Govt Engages Disqualified Nigerian Army 92 Regular Recruits Applicants & Approves Return Transport Allowance
ENUGU STATE (PSI 6.0): Ministry of Works & Infrastructure Announces Temporary Single-Lane Closure on Abakaliki Road for Maintenance

LAGOS (PSI 9.1): Commerce Commissioner Hon. Folashade Bada Ambrose-Medebem disclosed at the 5-in-1 Nigeria-China Trade Fair 2026 that Lagos attracted over ₦1 trillion in investments in 2025 and targets $50 billion in deals at IATF 2027; Gov. Babajide Sanwo-Olu's administration readied the 280-bed Ojo General Hospital for commissioning before year-end; and the Ministry of Tourism announced temporary closure of the J. Randle Centre for Yoruba Culture and History for gallery refurbishment.

ADAMAWA (PSI 8.9): Adamawa EXCO approved over ₦1.4 billion for a 1,500-capacity Fintiri Convocation Square at ADSU Mubi, over ₦249 million for GSS Madagali staff quarters, Adamawa Press Limited remodelling, and the 2027–2031 Demographic Dividend Roadmap; Works Commissioner Hon. Muhammad Suleiman inspected Jimeta Ultra-Modern Stadium roads and partnered with the NCC on a telecom protection task force; and Deputy Gov. Prof. Kaletapwa Farauta bade farewell to over 640 Christian pilgrims.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.7): Cross River inaugurated a seven-member committee for its Local Content Petty Traders Grant Support Programme (₦10,000 to ₦100,000 tranches); UNICROSS and Zhejiang College, China, launched a five-day Train-the-Trainers workshop in 3D Printing Technology and Chinese Language with three donated 3D printers; and Deputy Gov. Peter Odey fulfilled a ₦2 million cash grant and free health insurance enrolment to physically challenged Carnival Calabar dancer Richard Amos Ibor within 48 hours.

ONDO (PSI 8.1): Ondo State Ministry of Water Resources flagged off statewide distribution of water treatment tablets at Ipogun Town Hall, Ifedore LGA, to combat waterborne diseases such as Schistosomiasis and cholera, while Information Commissioner Hon. Idowu Ajanaku issued a statewide public health advisory urging hydration, sun protection, and classroom cross-ventilation amid prevailing heat wave conditions.

EDO (PSI 7.8): Coordinator of the Office of the Edo State First Lady Mrs. Edesili Okpebholo Anani flagged off the 11th Dr. Paddy Emmanuel Foundation free surgery outreach in Amagba, Benin City, providing free hernia, lipoma, fibroid, and breast lump surgeries for 100 patients, while Edo State Waste Management Board MD Amb. Dr. Lucky Enehita-Inegbenehi led a sanitation inspection across Oluku, Oliha Market, Ring Road, and Dawson Junction.

GOMBE (PSI 7.6): Gov. Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya visited Lawanti community in Akko LGA to console families affected by the fatal military shooting incident, donating ₦10 million (₦2m each to three bereaved families and ₦4m to community leadership, youth, and women) and pledging a thorough investigation and justice.

OYO (PSI 7.4): Gov. Seyi Makinde declared at the Governor Seyi Makinde Leadership Conference in Ibadan that Nigeria must shift from sharing federal allocations to productivity, entrepreneurship, and wealth creation, citing Oyo's Ibadan Airport upgrade, 110km Ibadan Circular Road, and Fasola Agribusiness Industrial Hub.

ABIA (PSI 7.2): The Abia State Government raised an alarm over an alleged plot by disgruntled political actors to destroy campaign billboards and buildings—specifically targeting those of President Bola Tinubu—to incite crisis, warning that perpetrators regardless of party affiliation will face full legal consequences.

BAYELSA (PSI 7.0): Gov. Douye Diri, through Bayelsa State Community Safety Corps Coordinator Rtd. Brig. Gen. Eric Angaye, presented a brand-new prosthetic leg, an instant ₦250,000 grant, an increased monthly salary, and spousal business support to Mr. Teacher Austin, who was injured in February 2026 protecting farmlands in Ogbia LGA.

ZAMFARA (PSI 6.9): Zamfara State Rural Water Supply and Sanitation Agency (RUWATSAN) Programme Manager Dr. Abubakar Nasir Galadima received a national award from Water Resources Minister Engr. Joseph Terlumun recognizing four Zamfara LGAs for attaining Open Defecation Free (ODF) status.

OSUN (PSI 6.8): Gov. Ademola Adeleke delivered a state broadcast launching activities for his second-term inauguration, paying tribute to citizens and pledging accelerated infrastructure delivery, deeper social services, and economic expansion for job creation.

BAUCHI (PSI 6.5): Gov. Bala Mohammed received an Afrimed delegation led by Co-Founder Mr. Georges Chabtini at Government House, Bauchi, to explore partnerships for supplying essential medical products to primary, secondary, and tertiary healthcare facilities.

KEBBI (PSI 6.3): Kebbi State Special Services Permanent Secretary Alhaji Aliyu Labaran visited barracks premises to counsel candidates disqualified from the Nigerian Army's 92 Regular Recruits Intake on medical, physical, and academic criteria, approving state transport allowances for their safe return home.

ENUGU (PSI 6.0): The Enugu State Ministry of Works and Infrastructure announced a temporary single-lane closure on Abakaliki Road from the Airport axis before the Underpass toward North-West Filling Station to execute essential road maintenance works.
